summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Implement the process on the documented SAP returns flow - a returns order created against the preceding document, an inbound receipt, a structured inspection whose outcome drives the follow-up activity, and a settlement leg - with the initiation gated in the dealer front-end.
why_new: No process documentation was found for this process, so there is no AS-IS to improve; the design starts from SAP standard and leading practice.
design_principles: Standard before extension: only extend where the SAP record and industry practice together show a need
Decide returnability before the part moves
Every disposition decision is structured data on the system of record

recommended_flow.name: Gated return initiation
recommended_flow.description: The dealer initiates the return through a guided front-end that validates the part before authorising movement.

recommended_flow.name: Returns order
recommended_flow.description: An authorised request creates the returns order with reference to the preceding sales document.

recommended_flow.name: Inbound receipt
recommended_flow.description: The returned product is received against an inbound delivery.

recommended_flow.name: Inspection and disposition
recommended_flow.description: The inspection result determines the follow-up activity and is recorded on the returns document.

recommended_flow.name: Settlement
recommended_flow.description: The disposition drives a credit or a coded rejection back to the dealer.

design_decisions.recommendation: Gate the decision at the dealer, before the part moves.
design_decisions.rationale: Avoids moving parts that will be rejected and gives the dealer an immediate answer.
design_decisions.sap_basis: The SAP record documents a returns order created with reference to the preceding sales document, which places the decision at order creation.
design_decisions.industry_basis: Leading networks make the returnability judgement at the point of diagnosis in the workshop.

evidence.quote: Leaders decide returnability at the point of diagnosis, before the part leaves the dealership.

design_decisions.decision: How is the inspection outcome captured?
options_considered: Structured disposition codes on the returns document
design_decisions.recommendation: Structured disposition codes recorded against the returns document.
design_decisions.rationale: Keeps the evidence on the system of record and makes the return stream analysable.
design_decisions.sap_basis: The SAP record documents an inspection whose result determines the follow-up activity for the returned material.
design_decisions.industry_basis: Inspection outcomes are captured against a controlled vocabulary rather than as narrative.

evidence.quote: The inspection result determines the follow-up activity for the returned material.

design_decisions.decision: How does the dealer see status?
design_decisions.recommendation: Expose returns document status to the dealer front-end.
design_decisions.rationale: Status chasing is the most common source of avoidable contact in this process.
design_decisions.industry_basis: Status is shared with the dealer continuously from initiation through to settlement.

configuration_scope: Returns document types and the follow-up activities driven by the inspection outcome
Disposition code catalogue and its mapping to follow-up activities
Inbound delivery and receiving configuration for the returns flow
master_data_prerequisites: Material master coverage for the returnable part range
Business partner data for every dealer expected to initiate returns
Serial or batch identification where individual units must be traced

responsibilities: Initiate the return through the guided front-end
Pack and despatch the authorised part
Record the inspection outcome and disposition code

integration_points: Dealer front-end to the returns order
risks: The disposition code catalogue is a cross-functional dependency on the critical path
Dealer adoption of a gated initiation needs training
roadmap_phases: Phase 1 - define the disposition code catalogue
Phase 2 - configure the standard returns flow with inspection
Phase 3 - connect the dealer front-end and open the process to the network
open_questions: Whether a standard SAP application covers the dealer-facing initiation was not established from the retrieved sources
assumptions: The returns flow documented in the retrieved SAP sources applies to this part category
